name: How long does it take to remove smoke smell from furniture?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove smoke smell from furniture?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for smoke odor removal from furniture depends on the extent of the damage, the type of furniture, and the chosen restoration methods. Simple cases might take a few days for cleaning and deodorization, while more severe or widespread smoke penetration, especially in highly porous items, could require a week or more. This duration often includes necessary drying and airing processes after treatment. We prioritize efficient service while ensuring thorough odor elimination. During our initial assessment, we can provide a more precise timeline for your specific furniture items.
acceptedAnswer.description: The time varies based on damage severity, furniture type, and restoration methods, ranging from a few days to over a week for complex cases.
